summary: Iteration 146: Companies Bug Fix - All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend verified working. The GET /api/companies endpoint no longer crashes with KeyError: 'company_entity_id'. Companies page shows 17 companies with proper status badges, contacts count, and expandable rows. Company sharing endpoint /api/company-sharing/members also fixed (no KeyError on membership_id).
critical_code_review_comments: companies.py list_companies (line ~158) correctly handles missing company_entity_id by using: ce_id = company.get('company_entity_id') or company.get('entity_id')
companies.py get_company (line ~229) queries by both company_entity_id and entity_id using $or operator
companies.py normalizes field name for frontend (line ~167): if 'company_entity_id' not in company and 'entity_id' in company: company['company_entity_id'] = company['entity_id']
company_sharing.py get_company_members (line ~182) uses .get() for membership_id with fallback: m.get('membership_id', f"mem_{m.get('user_id','unknown')}")
server.py startup migration _migrate_company_entity_ids (line ~11376) auto-fixes records with entity_id or id but no company_entity_id

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Companies page loads, 17 companies displayed, expansion works, contacts section visible)
